bad_pattern: Hardcoded hex/rgb color literals inside JSX/TSX/Vue/Svelte component styles or Tailwind arbitrary brackets (bg-[#6366f1])
why_it_fails: Breaks light/dark mode parity, theme customization, and automated contrast guarantees.
fix_pattern: Bind exclusively to semantic CSS variables or Tailwind @theme tokens (bg-accent, text-text-muted, border-border).

bad_pattern: Purple-to-indigo-to-cyan gradient blobs/text on dark #0f172a backgrounds
why_it_fails: Generic AI boilerplate aesthetic lacking domain intentionality.
fix_pattern: Select a grounded domain palette from palettes.json and build contrast through typography, surface steps, and layout rhythm.

bad_pattern: Lorem ipsum, Acme Corp, John Doe, Jane Doe, TODO, FIXME, or TITAN_DRAFT markers left in shipped UI
why_it_fails: Signals unfinished mock output and breaks realistic text wrapping validation.
fix_pattern: Author realistic domain-authentic fixtures, action-oriented labels, and complete interactive states.

why_it_fails: Accidently animates layout properties (width/height/padding) or font styles on state changes, harming frame pacing.
fix_pattern: Specify explicit GPU-safe properties: transition-[transform,opacity,background-color,border-color] duration-150 ease-out.

bad_pattern: Animating width, height, top, left, margin, or padding in CSS transitions/keyframes
why_it_fails: Forces main-thread layout recalculation on every frame, causing visible jank.
fix_pattern: Use transform (translate3d/scale), opacity, clip-path, or grid-template-rows: 0fr -> 1fr for accordions.

bad_pattern: CSS animations/transitions or Motion primitives with no prefers-reduced-motion media query or MotionConfig
why_it_fails: Causes vestibular discomfort and violates WCAG 2.2 Animation from Interactions.
fix_pattern: Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) fallback in base CSS and <MotionConfig reducedMotion='user'> at app root.

bad_pattern: outline: none / outline-none / focus:outline-none without a replacement focus-visible ring
fix_pattern: Pair focus:outline-none with focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[var(--ring)] focus-visible:ring-offset-2.

bad_pattern: <div onClick={...}> or <span onClick={...}> used instead of native <button> or <a>
why_it_fails: Missing keyboard Enter/Space activation, focusability, and screen-reader button/link role.
fix_pattern: Replace with <button type='button'> or <a href='...'> (or add explicit role, tabIndex={0}, and onKeyDown if genuinely custom).

why_it_fails: Corrupts component state and breaks list transition choreography when items reorder, filter, or delete.
Clips bottom bars and CTAs behind dynamic mobile browser toolbars.

bad_pattern: Components taking 6+ boolean flags (hasHeader, showBorder, isCompact, withFooterIcon, noPadding)
why_it_fails: Creates exponential edge-case branches and rigid layouts.
fix_pattern: Refactor to compound subcomponents (<Card.Header>, <Card.Body>) and discrete cva variants.

why_it_fails: Exposes window.opener reference to external origins.
fix_pattern: Always pair target='_blank' with rel='noopener noreferrer'.
